fixed_transform_class.name: SHARED_EQUIVALENCE_PROXY_OCCURRENCE_REDIRECTION
definition: Choose an original variable x and fresh auxiliary y.
Redirect an arbitrary subset of occurrences of x/not-x in original clauses to y/not-y with the same polarity.
Add the exact equivalence clauses (not x OR y) and (x OR not y), enforcing y=x.
fixed_transform_class.sharing: The single proxy y may replace arbitrarily many occurrences across arbitrarily many clauses.
fixed_transform_class.exactness: Existentially forgetting y recovers exactly the original Boolean function because y is forced equal to x.

maxdef_nondecrease_theorem.statement: For every normalized CNF F, delta*(T_equiv(F)) >= delta*(F). If some maximum-deficiency witness A of F contains x, then delta*(T_equiv(F)) >= delta*(F)+1.
proof: Let A be an original sub-clause-set attaining delta*(F), and let A' be its redirected transformed copy.
If x is absent from A, then A'=A on the relevant variables and already witnesses deficiency delta*(F), so maxdef cannot decrease.

Assume x occurs in A. If A' uses both x and y, then A' has one more variable than A and deficiency delta(A)-1; adding both equivalence clauses adds two clauses and no further variables, giving deficiency delta(A)+1.
If all x-occurrences of A are redirected so A' uses y but not x, then A' has the same number of variables as A; adding both equivalence clauses adds x plus two clauses, again giving delta(A)+1.
If none of A's x-occurrences is redirected, A' uses x but not y; adding both equivalence clauses adds y plus two clauses, again giving delta(A)+1.
These cases exhaust all occurrence-redirection patterns on A.

R44BD_effect.meaning: A shared functional copy variable does not buy maximum-deficiency descent; on any maxdef witness containing the proxied variable, the standard two-clause equivalence gadget increases the witnessed deficiency by one.
R44BD_effect.relation_to_R44BG: R44BG used one-way polarity-aware private occurrence links and exactly conserved maxdef. R44BJ uses one shared proxy with full two-way equivalence and obtains a nondecrease/strict-witness-growth barrier.
R44BD_effect.selector_application: Replacing repeated selector/branch variables by exact equivalent proxies cannot repair raw selector maxdef debt by itself.

not_covered: semantic simplifications that remove clauses after proxy insertion

next_admissible_math.question: Fix one genuinely multi-input shared functional auxiliary gadget, such as a standard Tseitin AND/OR/XOR definition used across branches, and prove rank descent or an exact maxdef barrier.
next_admissible_math.forbidden: Do not count more single-variable equivalence proxies as a new route.
